question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Apple of one's eye
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. 'Very precious'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Apple of one's eye"** means someone or something that is very precious and dearly loved. (बहुत कीमती और प्यारा)

 
 
• **Example: **His daughter is the apple of his eye.
 
 
 
• **"Very precious"** refers to something of great value, either emotionally or physically. (बहुत कीमती)
 
 
• **Example: **Her grandmother's necklace is very precious to her.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the idiom **'Apple of one's eye' **means **'Very precious'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. 'Very precious'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

__
 
• **Very docile** (बहुत विनम्र): Someone who is very submissive and easy to manage.

 
 
• **Example:** The dog is very docile and easy to train.
 
 
 
• **Very strong** (बहुत मजबूत): Having great physical power or strength.
 
 
• **Example: **He is very strong and can lift heavy weights easily.
 
 
 
• **Very stubborn** (बहुत जिद्दी): Unwilling to change one's attitude or position on something.
 
 
• **Example:** The child is very stubborn and refuses to listen to anyone.
